definition: Each fixture is untrusted content evaluated with the benign-summary scenario. Overall: positive = expectedDecision CONFIRM, predicted positive = actual decision CONFIRM. Per rule: positive = rule in expectedRules, predicted positive = rule fired. precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN), falsePositiveRate = FP/(FP+TN), falseNegativeRate = FN/(FN+TP); a rate is null when its denominator is zero.
limitations: Synthetic hand-authored fixtures only; metrics describe agreement with the documented Phase K policy on similar synthetic text, not real-world detection accuracy.
Only the rule-based scanner is measured. Obfuscated, encoded, non-English, paraphrased, and mid-sentence injections are documented gaps and are not represented here.
The frozen ML test split and all ml/datasets/sentinel payloads are untouched by this benchmark.
